description: This Utrecht University archive contains the global input files for PCR-GLOBWB 2 release 2017_11_beta_1. The own Zenodo description identifies parameter sets at five-arcminute and thirty-arcminute resolution and links them to the public hydrological model. The resource is a versioned data package, not the model source or the paper describing it. Its approximately 45 GB compressed TAR archive is available free under CC-BY-4.0. It can provide inputs for global or regional water-resource simulations, including studies of water availability and infrastructure demand. Temporal coverage and individual internal file formats were not established from the public archive metadata, so they remain uncertain. A limitation is that this archived input version must be matched to compatible model code and configuration; the current model README also points to a later input release. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1045338 resolves to version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1045339. The PCR-GLOBWB code is already covered in the catalogue and first review. This review did not download the data.
